Class HomeService

java.lang.Object
services.HomeService
public class HomeService extends Object
Central service for managing orders during a session. Holds the in-memory list of orders and tracks which one is currently active. Implemented as a singleton since order state needs to persist across the lifetime of the application without being re-fetched constantly.
